thread:
lucy_sales: Quick heads-up — we just published the new pricelist (v5). Main differences: APAC GEO exceptions for certain GPU SKUs, clarified commit tiers, and a new one-off 'migration credit' workflow. Please read before pushing any quotes. :loud_sound:
omar_dealdesk: where's the doc? link?
lucy_sales: https://redwood.internal/pricing/pricelist-v5 (internal) — pinned summary at top, full diff under 'changelog' section.
sarah_revops: Thanks Lucy. Two quick Qs: 1) Are existing signed deals auto-grandfathered onto v4 pricing or can reps request v4 pricing for renewals? 2) How do we surface the APAC exception to customers (note: legal wants explicit T&Cs)?
omar_dealdesk: For (1) the default is grandfathering for contracts signed before 2026-04-01. We can submit an exception if the customer has a commitment + closing approved discount. Use the Deal Desk form and tag me.
devon_se: Exception process — can you paste the smallest required fields so AE's don't miss anything?
omar_dealdesk: Minimal: customer name, existing contract ID, requested effective pricing (v4/v5 delta), ARR impact, requested approval TTL, and justification (migration, parity, strategic). Attach the signed contract PDF if available.
priya_security: On the APAC exception: security reviewed the change. Note: any customer requesting Private deployment + APAC exception must run the new data residency checklist (see section 4.2). We need SOC2 evidence on file before we approve the exception.
jason_finance: Migration credit: finance needs a sample amortization schedule. Suggest we cap credit at 3 months of committed spend for SMB, scaled for enterprise. I'll draft numbers and post a table.
lucy_sales: Good call. Also a small ops note — API SKUs were renamed (old sku -> new sku mapping in the changelog). Please do not type the old SKU into quotes; it will reject in the quoting tool. Example mapping in case you need to script lookups:
```
OLD: redwood-gpu-x1  -> NEW: rwd-gpu-x1-v2
OLD: redwood-embed-s -> NEW: rwd-embed-s-v3
```
sarah_revops: Can we add a quick lookup CLI for AE's? I can patch a one-liner to Slackbot. Something like: `curl -sS $PRICING_URL/api/sku-map | jq -r ".[] | \"\(.old) -> \(.new)\""`
ratecard-bot: pricelist v5 published by lucy_sales at 1769998875. Changelog available: /pricing/pricelist-v5/changelog.
devon_se: AEs in ANZ asked if we can temporarily waive the onboarding fee for customers migrating from competitor X — is that an exception or standard discount?
omar_dealdesk: That's an exception. If it's 1x onboarding waiver, handle via a standard Deal Desk approval and quote as a $0 line item with comment; finance will track as a deferred revenue adjustment. If it's larger, we need a commercial note in the contract.
priya_security: Reminder: any deviation that reduces logging/auditability (e.g., omitting audit logs for on-prem installs) is automatic fail — don't submit that as an exception unless security signs off.
jason_finance: I'll add the migration credit amortization and a sample CSV for quoting tool. ETA EOD.
lucy_sales: Thanks all. Action items: @omar_dealdesk — publish a Deal Desk template for v5 exceptions; @sarah_revops — add CLI lookup to slackbot; @jason_finance — post amortization CSV; @priya_security — link the data residency checklist in the changelog. I'll follow up in #sales-sync tomorrow 9:30 PT. :thumbsup:
